name: Turkey
source:
In a small cold country you can smell turkey on Christmas Eve whenever you go. It makes everyone feel happy and cozy. A girl in rags moves from the beach towards town center. This grim girl turns out to be a devil who brings nothing good to the human race.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在一个寒冷小国，每逢圣诞夜，无论走到哪里都能闻见烤火鸡的香味，令所有人感到幸福而温暖。一名衣衫褴褛的少女从海滩走向镇中心。这个阴沉女孩其实是恶魔，她给人类带来的绝不会是好事。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vndb-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
